reason: My renderer is gone and I need someone reliable, and a free build of one of my own plans with no deposit costs me a lunch. If it looks good I'd pay for that one plan and then see how it holds up.
objection: I get calls from people doing this all the time and most of them can't deliver the same quality twice. I need to know the one-day turnaround holds when I send 10 plans, and that the walkthrough matches what we actually build.
